scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && python -m uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.start: cd backend && python -m uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && python -m uv run pytest
scripts.gen:api: cd backend && python -m uv run python -m app.export_openapi .openapi.json && cd .. && openapi-typescript backend/.openapi.json -o frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts --default-non-nullable false
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && python -m uv sync
